t: This is Camden Town station on the Northern line, and it's a busy one. It is the junction where the Edgware and High Barnet branches join from the north. To the south they split again into the Bank and Charing Cross branches. At weekends it fills with visitors heading for the Camden markets, and until 2019 it was exit-only on Sundays to prevent overcrowding. The architect was Leslie Green, who is best known for the London Underground stations he designed in the 1900s. They have oxblood red faïence blocks, semi-circular first-floor windows and tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
